import { DocsAgentIndex } from '@/components/docs/docs-agent-index';

<DocsAgentIndex />

**π-SPI** is the BCEAO instant account-to-account rail for the UEMOA. Currency is **XOF**. In the API the identifier stays `SPI`.

## Countries

| Code | Country |
| --- | --- |
| BJ | Benin |
| BF | Burkina Faso |
| CI | Côte d'Ivoire |
| GW | Guinea-Bissau |
| ML | Mali |
| NE | Niger |
| SN | Senegal |
| TG | Togo |

A bank account in one of these countries is a π-SPI destination. Euro and dollar payouts stay on the treasury rail.

## At a glance

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Approval | The payer scans a merchant QR, or confirms a request sent to their alias |
| Settlement | After the bank confirms, then `available_at` |
| Direct vs hosted | Hosted checkout, `POST /payment-requests` (XOF returns `qr_payload`), and `POST /charge/spi` |
| Refund | Not listed on `POST /refunds` |
| Min / max | - |

Same columns as [Payment channels](/build/payment-channels#channel-capabilities).

## Where it shows up

- **Dashboard payouts.** A UEMOA bank account is marked π-SPI. The withdrawal is sent when the bank confirms, not over several business days.
- **lomi.** The same account shows π-SPI on the withdraw screen. QR pay follows the org’s π-SPI status.
- **Checkout.** π-SPI is offered when the organization has it connected and the environment can take the payment. The payer enters their alias.
- **Invoices.** A request-to-pay needs the customer alias. The invoice shows that alias and the QR when they are on the payment details.

## Payouts

XOF withdrawals with `rail: "bank"` or `rail: "spi"` are π-SPI credit transfers to a registered payout method. See [Payouts](/build/money/payouts).
